Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear ask. Draft MAP attached (MAP_draft_20261201.docx) and a short high-level sequence below. I focused on minimizing blockers so your Jan window is possible.

High-level recommended sequence (critical path in bold):
1) Security intake & SOC2 evidence (parallelizable) — we can share our SOC2 package and run through your security questionnaire simultaneously with legal review.
2) MSA negotiation (critical) — target 2 weeks for redlines; can be shortened with a single consolidated round and our standard playbook.
3) DPA review (parallel with MSA where possible) — many customers approve DPA after MSA, but Legal can review concurrently to save time.
4) Order form (dependent) — final order form requires agreed MSA terms and pricing sign-off.
5) PO issuance & procurement approval (dependent) — procurement needs signed MSA and order form + SOC evidence.

Key dates (proposal):
- Share SOC2 + security pack: by 2026-12-03
- MSA redline cycle: 2026-12-04 -> 2026-12-15 (aim for signed MSA by 12/17)
- DPA sign-off: concurrent review 12/04 -> 12/18
- Order form finalization & signatures: 12/18 -> 12/22
- PO & internal procurement approvals: target completed by 12/29

If we hit the milestones above, we can stand up the pilot environment in the first week of January and go-live mid-Jan as requested. I've also attached our suggested fallback policy: if MSA redlines exceed 3 business days of back-and-forth, we propose a one-time escalation to our Legal lead (Lauren) to lock a binding minimal terms set.

Attachments: MAP_draft_20261201.docx

Thanks — happy to sync live if preferred.

Best,

Hi Elaine / team — looping in a few practical notes from Legal so procurement can plan:

1) MSA focus areas: indemnities, data residency & use, and termination for convenience. We'll propose a limited set of edits in MSA_v2_redlines.pdf to keep cycles short.
2) DPA: most DPA items are standard and can be approved in parallel, but any bespoke data localization requests will push the critical path. Please flag if you need EU-only processing or special export controls.
3) Order form: price + initial capacity must be agreed but placeholder quantities are fine to sign the order form if you include a not-to-exceed clause. That can unblock procurement while we finalize exact counts.

Practical gating recommendation: get SOC2 + security questionnaire returned + our standard MSA redline packet back to us within 7 business days. If we don't receive redlines in that window, we'll assume acceptance of our standard playbook and can proceed to sign.

I've attached our redline packet and a DPA summary for your counsel to review.

Attachments: MSA_v2_redlines.pdf; DPA_summary.xlsx

—Lauren
